verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Make's own MCP server, where Claude, ChatGPT and other AI systems act as clients that call Make scenarios. Nothing shows Make itself, or its AI Agents app, connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools. Server-side evidence is a different product role and does not transfer to this client-side story, and the AI Agents mention does not reference MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
